timing.method: Elapsed intervals are observed UTC wall clock. Mixed initial orientation/search is conservatively credited; later active phases logged prospectively. No idle or overlapping credit. Category estimates are not second-accurate telemetry.

intervals.note: Conservative 10-minute literature credit only; registration, orientation, compaction and preliminary derivations excluded from useful/theory floors.

intervals.focus: Balanced compression, finite-bank risk, exact first-layer controls, output-sensitive response rank; primary-source lookups used only to resolve derivation dependencies.
intervals.note: Observed continuous research interval. Conservative active credit for written derivations and small mathematical checks; two minutes of primary-source refresh separated; remaining elapsed time uncredited for messages/tools/record overhead.

intervals.focus: Challenge the compressed-source full-history K3 route: source distortion, complete cost, numerical safeguards and a bounded implementation decision.
intervals.note: Conservative credit for source compression, nonlinear transmission, tail identities, rectangular costs and repeated-matrix refinement; approximately five minutes of compaction plus remaining administrative/message overhead excluded.

intervals.focus: Confirm public cumulant method scope and compression-source attribution before selection; no broad new search.
intervals.note: Mixed source confirmation and selection-changing derivation. Source status and theorem assumptions checked; full repeated source reparameterized and analytic pair table derived. Remaining record/message overhead excluded.

intervals.focus: Final source attribution, executable equation handoff, cost and candidate decision, scoped route/state/event records and verification.
intervals.note: Useful candidate selection, mathematical implementation handoff, source attribution, scoped state/event records and review. One additional minute conservatively excluded for messages/tool overhead; no idle credit.

timing.category_precision: Conservative activity estimates within observed UTC intervals, not second-accurate telemetry.

route_allocation_note: Approximate split of83 conservatively credited active theory minutes; mixed work assigned once, source/file times anchor chronology, not a per-keystroke activity audit.
